lines.text: The commander brought Paul before the Sanhedrin, and Paul said he had lived before God in good conscience.
The high priest Ananias ordered Paul struck on the mouth, and Paul called him a whitewashed wall.
Paul said he did not know the man was the commander, quoting Scripture against speaking evil about their ruler.
Paul said he was on trial for his hope in the resurrection, and the Pharisees and Sadducees began to dispute.
The commander ordered soldiers to remove Paul by force, and that night an angel told him to take courage.
